lines.t: # Every Wonder
**Verse 1**
Every bird that sings at morning,
Every wing that takes to flight,
Every song across the branches,
You have filled the world with life.
Every creature, great and tiny,
Every path they wander through,
There are wonders all around me,
Every one points back to You.
**Chorus**
Every star You hung in the sky,
Every flower You caused to bloom,
Every new day, every sunrise,
Every wonder, it's all because of You.
**Verse 2**
Every painted leaf,
Every shade of red and gold,
Every snowflake falling softly,
Each one different, new and old
Every ray of morning sunshine,
Every cloud that drifts above,
There is beauty in the smallest things,
There is wonder in Your work.
**Chorus**
Every star You hung in the sky,
Every flower You caused to bloom,
Every new day, every sunrise,
Every wonder, it's all because of You.
**Bridge**
From the depths beneath the ocean
To the heavens stretching wide,
Everywhere I turn, I find it—
Your fingerprints in all I see.
And if all of this is only
A glimpse of who You are,
Then forever I'll keep wondering
How great You really are.
**Final Chorus**
Every star You hung in the sky,
Every flower You caused to bloom,
Every new day, every sunrise,
Every wonder, it's all because of You.
Every wonder, its all because of You
